tools_helpful.evidence: Bootstrap self-check returned True; agent proceeded file-by-file without hand-inventorying the source (session-log.txt ~L250).

Agent migrated CaptureElement -> Image + SoftwareBitmapSource and kept a non-blank fallback; all 3 scenarios render a non-blank frame and Initialize Camera actuates (migration-score.json winui_observations).

tool_limitations.limitation: The only place the skill tells the agent to set AutomationProperties is the camera-preview <Image> in PATTERNS.md#capture. The agent applied it there and NOWHERE else, so interactive controls (ComboBox/Button) were left with only x:Name, which is not exposed as AutomationId in the UIA tree.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Add a general, prominent rule to set AutomationProperties.AutomationId on every interactive control during XAML migration; back it with a validator advisory.

doc_errors.wrong: 'preserve the name/AutomationProperties so parity checks still match' implies keeping the XAML x:Name is enough for automation matching.
doc_errors.correct: x:Name is NOT surfaced as AutomationId in the UIA tree. Automation/parity matching needs AutomationProperties.AutomationId (or a discoverable Name/label) explicitly set on the control.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Control renders correctly but is absent from the captured UIA tree, dropping structural coverage to 2/3 (scenario held at PARTIAL).
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: n/a — not a stuck loop; a silent fidelity gap the agent never knew to close
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: ComboBox identity is only x:Name='VideoSettings' + PlaceholderText; no AutomationProperties.AutomationId. x:Name does not appear in the UIA tree, and placeholder-text matching is unreliable, so the structural matcher missed it.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: A migration-skill rule (Tier 3) + Validate-UwpMigration advisory (Tier 1) that requires AutomationProperties.AutomationId on every interactive control.

missing_tooling.need: A validator advisory that flags interactive controls lacking AutomationProperties.AutomationId.
missing_tooling.would_have_saved: The Scenario 3 partial (2/3 -> 3/3) and improves accessibility across every migrated app.

env_issues.issue: No camera on the box; the original UWP app stalled on splash so no behavioral UWP baseline could be captured.
env_issues.workaround: Score rests on structural coverage + WinUI actuation; not a migration defect.
